notes.title: The drone attack!
notes.content:
Hello mercenaries,

We have just released a new update, and it brings a new threat to your battles, the drones.
Waves of drones will be created every 2 minutes, and there is also a small chance of these waves being created at each enemy spawn.

I hope you like the changes.

Until the next update!

notes.title: Survivor game mode
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am thrilled to announce the release of the third upgrade to our roguelike game. This upgrade introduces an exciting new game mode called "Just Survive," which provides players with a classic survival experience, where the primary objective is to survive.

We have made several adjustments to the enemy spawn system to ensure that the difficulty level is appropriately balanced. This compensates for the increasing difficulty effect present in the main mode when an energy drain occurs.

Your feedback and suggestions are invaluable to us, and we encourage you to share them on our forum. We are eager to hear your thoughts about the new upgrade. See you on the next hostile planet!

notes.title: I found the bug!
notes.content:
Greetings to our Chinese players,

I am pleased to announce that I have identified and resolved the issue causing the game screen to freeze for players using the Simplified Chinese language. The root of the problem was in the character {, which on the Chinese keyboard is slightly different from ｛.
It was unexpected to discover that this minor detail was causing the problem. As a result, I would like to sincerely apologize to all players impacted by this issue and for any inconvenience caused by the delay in addressing it.

Going forward, I am confident that the game will perform smoothly. However, if the problem persists, please do not hesitate to share your concerns with us on our forum.

We appreciate your patience and understanding throughout this process and thank you for your continued support.

Best regards,

Matheus, Game Developer

notes.title: Minimap
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow mercenaries!

We heard your feedback loud and clear, and we've been hard at work preparing an update that will take your intergalactic battles to the next level.

We're thrilled to announce the addition of the minimap in the lower right corner of your screen! It will display your character's location, energy drain points, and boxes. But here's the question: would you prefer the minimap to be enabled for everyone or should we make it an upgrade in the skill tree? And for those hardcore players, would you like an option to turn it off and increase the difficulty?

But wait, there's more! We've also included four new achievements that are related to skill tree progression. Show off your skills and compete against your friends to see who's the top player.

We've made some balancing changes that will shake things up in the game:

* Increased the damage of all spells to make them even more powerful
* Slightly reduced the damage of spawned bullets
* Boosted the Hunter's ultimate by increasing the damage
* The rifle and shotgun skill tree update inflicted an overly high amount of damage, but it has been mitigated now.

This is our latest update, so get ready to grab your weapons and dive into battle! And don't forget to send us your suggestions for future improvements so we can work together to make the game even more fun.

notes.title: AUTO AIM & AUTO SHOT
notes.content:
Hello!

Exciting news, folks! I'm thrilled to announce that the first patch for Energy Survivors is officially out. With the AUTO SHOT and AUTO AIM options now activated, players can move around freely without the hassle of aiming or shooting.

Thanks to your feedback, I've made some tweaks to the reload mechanic, reducing the time needed for "quick reload" and making it more consistent and seamless.

On top of that, I've also implemented some general adjustments and bug fixes to improve the overall gameplay experience.

But I'm not done yet! I'd love to hear your thoughts on the recent changes and any suggestions you may have for future updates. After all, Energy Survivors is a game in development, and your input is crucial in helping me make it even better.

Before I sign off, there's one more thing I need to address. I've noticed a rare bug that occasionally freezes the update screen and obstructs the game screen, preventing players from selecting an option. I'm working hard to fix this issue, but I need your assistance. If you encounter this bug, please notify us on the forum and provide a brief description of what led up to the error.

Thank you for your attention and let's continue the Energy Survivors adventure together!

Dev
Matheus

notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We are excited to announce that Energy Survivors was launched yesterday, and we have already released the first patch to fix a couple of bugs.
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where it was possible to apply the effect of injections multiple times.
[*] Fixed the bug by navigating between the main and options menus.
[/list]
We have many exciting ideas that we plan to implement in the game, and we would love to hear your feedback to make Energy Survivors an even more thrilling experience for everyone.

Stay tuned for further updates, as we have more exciting news to share soon.

notes.title: Early Access is out NOW!
notes.content:
Hello mercenaries!

Are you ready to step into the world of [b]ENERGY SURVIVORS[/b]? The wait is over, and the game is finally available for everyone to play! We can't wait to see the incredible builds and unique gameplay styles that you will bring to the table.

[previewyoutube=sTiYAOYeRLw;full][/previewyoutube]

We want to take a moment to express our gratitude for your unwavering support throughout the development process. Your feedback and suggestions have been invaluable in shaping the game and making it the best it can be. We are confident that with your continued collaboration, we can take the game to new heights.

So, are you ready to compete for energy in this thrilling new world? Get ready to embark on an adventure like no other and show off your skills as a true ENERGY SURVIVOR.

notes.title: Early Access on April 17th!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are thrilled to announce that Energy Survivors, the third-person shooter roguelite game, [b]will be coming to Early Access on April 17th! [/b]

[previewyoutube=sTiYAOYeRLw;full][/previewyoutube]
As a mercenary on a hostile planet, your mission is to find the planet's energy source and survive against all odds.

In Energy Survivors, you'll have the opportunity to choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and powerful builds that can change the course of the game. With the beginning of Early Access, you'll have access to all the main planned features in the game, including new characters, weapons, and new skills to master.

Our team is committed to continuing development and supporting Energy Survivors for a long time to come. We are constantly exploring new ways to enhance the game mechanics and make the player experience even better.

So mark your calendars for [b]April 17th[/b] and join us on this exciting journey through the hostile planet.

[b]Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to see you in Energy Survivors![/b]

notes.title: Enhancing the Gaming Experience: New and Improved Visuals
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce a major visual upgrade to our game! We've been hard at work improving the game's visuals, including a complete rework of illumination, shaders, and post-processing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/824e8e9059d71ef01dab2be57791afd19a7b1fe3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/b15892ce1b51c7c0bfbc8ad3b33ab344b473675a.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the updated visuals in our game!

notes.title: Play the Demo Now!
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! A new demo has just been released on Steam! 

Get ready for a thrilling adventure in the world of ENERGY HEIST! Play as a mercenary on a mission to invade a hostile planet in search of its energy source. This third-person shooter roguelite game lets you create unique builds with a variety of upgrades, giving you the power to change the outcome of the game. Experience intense combat and risk it all in the pursuit of energy. Download the demo now on Steam!

notes.title: New languages supported
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! We are excited to announce that a demo version of our game will be available on Steam during the next festival. And we are also thrilled to let you know that the demo will initially support four languages: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.

Get a taste of the game in your preferred language and see for yourself the hard work we have put into ensuring accurate translations. This is your chance to try out the game before it's officially released and give us your valuable feedback.

Mark your calendars and don't miss the opportunity to be among the first to play the demo in your native language. We'll see you on Steam at the festival!

notes.title: Choose Your Playstyle in Energy Heist: Ranger, Hunter, or Cyborg?
notes.content:
Welcome to [b]Energy Heist[/b], a third-person shooter roguelite game where you play as a mercenary on a mission to invade a hostile planet in search of its energy source. [b]You'll have the choice of three unique characters, each with their own special abilities and playstyle.[/b]

First up is the [b]Ranger[/b], a highly mobile and agile character with the ability to dash forward in combat with their special ability, or "ult." This makes them great at closing the distance and taking on enemies in close combat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/9d238b1711d7b8e41c0b2b46921d2276a7d08c35.gif[/img]

Next is the [b]Hunter[/b], a mercenary with the ability to quickly regenerate their health in battle. They also have a powerful ult that unleashes a slash attack, damaging all enemies in their vicinity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/99fb593ccdf72ac8604095e0c46aaf48f4ec888e.gif[/img]

Finally, there's the [b]Cyborg[/b], a heavily-armored character with impressive defense capabilities. They have an ult that renders them invulnerable for a short time, allowing them to withstand even the strongest of enemy attacks. With their formidable defenses and powerful abilities, the Cyborg is a force on the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/5c710e2d18351f77b1376518a3bf881a1dba22a8.gif[/img]

Which character will you choose in Energy Heist? Will you go for the mobility and agility of the Ranger, the regenerative powers of the Hunter, or the formidable defenses of the Cyborg? The choice is yours!

[b]Do you have any ideas for cool features in ENERGY HEIST? We'd love to hear them in the comments.[/b]

notes.title: Get ready to explore the origins of ENERGY HEIST and witness its transformation!
notes.content:
As a mercenary in the third-person shooter roguelite game ENERGY HEIST, you'll be part of an exciting adventure that started with a simple idea.

At the beginning of the project, the game was just a concept in my mind. I wanted to create a unique and challenging experience that would allow players to explore a hostile planet and uncover its secrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/27a82f06ecffe4078f7e154a8d8917363785c9ac.png[/img]

I started by sketching out the basic gameplay mechanics, such as the character and weapon shapes, the upgrades and perks, and the enemy forces and obstacles. I also designed the overall look and feel of the game, from the colorful and dynamic visuals to the atmospheric and immersive sound effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/9dbae3fb67b79f4097cd063c959082875d25aebd.png[/img]

As the project progressed, I added more features and content to the game, such as new character and weapon shapes, new upgrades and perks, and new enemies and challenges. They also refined and polished the gameplay, the graphics, and the audio, to make the game more engaging and satisfying for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43128597/7dd4cc5cf5575d15274434b5e50f2b23795e1a9e.png[/img]

So when you start playing ENERGY HEIST, remember that it all began with a simple idea that grew and evolved into the exciting and thrilling game that you'll experience.

[b]Do you have any ideas for cool features in ENERGY HEIST? We'd love to hear them in the comments.[/b]
